title: Pumpkin Pie
description: A smooth, gently spiced pumpkin custard in a flaky crust, made with canned pumpkin and evaporated milk. Set it the day before.

image.alt: A pumpkin pie with whipped cream and a slice cut

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} with a baking sheet on a rack in the lower third. Fit the crust into the pie plate and crimp the edge.
Whisk the pumpkin, evaporated milk, eggs, brown sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves and salt until completely smooth.
Pour the filling into the crust and set it on the hot baking sheet. Bake for {time 15 min}.
Lower the heat to {temp 350F oven} and bake until the edges are set and the center still wobbles slightly when nudged, {time 40-45 min}. It should read about {temp 175F internal} in the center.
Cool on a rack for at least {time 2 hr notimer}, then chill. The custard finishes setting as it cools.

notes: Cracks mean the pie baked too long; take it out while the center still jiggles.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Serve with whipped cream.
